  select gml_id, lon, lat from sig_energia.venteo_detectado
  where fecha >= date '2024-01-01' and lon is not null and lat is not null
),
src as (
  select 'c'::text k, id_concesion id, anillo::jsonb g from sig_energia.concesion where anillo is not null and anillo <> ''
  union all
  select 'a', gid, anillos::jsonb from ign.area_protegida where anillos is not null and anillos <> ''

rings as (
  select k, id, 1::bigint n, g ring from src where jsonb_typeof(g->0->0) = 'number'

  select k, id, e.n, e.r from src, jsonb_array_elements(g) with ordinality e(r, n)
  where jsonb_typeof(g->0->0) = 'array' and jsonb_typeof(g->0->0->0) = 'number'
  union all
  select k, id, p.n * 100000 + e.n, e.r from src, jsonb_array_elements(g) with ordinality p(poly, n),
       jsonb_array_elements(p.poly) with ordinality e(r, n2)
  where jsonb_typeof(g->0->0->0) = 'array'
),
pts as (
  select k, id, n, e.ord, (e.v->>0)::float8 x, (e.v->>1)::float8 y
  from rings, jsonb_array_elements(ring) with ordinality e(v, ord)
),
edges as (
  select k, id, x x1, y y1,
         coalesce(lead(x) over w, first_value(x) over w) x2,
         coalesce(lead(y) over w, first_value(y) over w) y2
  from pts window w as (partition by k, id, n order by ord)
),
bbox as (
  select k, id, min(x1) minx, max(x1) maxx, min(y1) miny, max(y1) maxy from edges group by k, id
),
inside as (
  select d.gml_id, e.k, e.id
  from det d

  group by d.gml_id, e.k, e.id
  having count(*) % 2 = 1
)
select count(distinct i.gml_id) from inside i
where i.k = 'c' and exists (select 1 from inside j where j.gml_id = i.gml_id and j.k = 'a')

  where fecha >= date '2024-01-01' and lon is not null and lat is not null
),
src as materialized (
  select 'c'::text k, id_concesion id, anillo::jsonb g from sig_energia.concesion where anillo is not null and anillo <> ''
  union all
  select 'a', gid, anillos::jsonb from ign.area_protegida where anillos is not null and anillos <> ''
),
rings as materialized (
  select k, id, 1::bigint n, g ring from src where jsonb_typeof(g->0->0) = 'number'
  union all
  select k, id, e.n, e.r from src, jsonb_array_elements(g) with ordinality e(r, n)
  where jsonb_typeof(g->0->0) = 'array' and jsonb_typeof(g->0->0->0) = 'number'
  union all
  select k, id, p.n * 100000 + e.n2, e.r from src, jsonb_array_elements(g) with ordinality p(poly, n),
       jsonb_array_elements(p.poly) with ordinality e(r, n2)
  where jsonb_typeof(g->0->0->0) = 'array'
),
pts as materialized (
  select k, id, n, e.ord, (e.v->>0)::float8 x, (e.v->>1)::float8 y
  from rings, jsonb_array_elements(ring) with ordinality e(v, ord)
),
edges as materialized (
  select k, id, x1, y1, x2, y2 from (
    select k, id, x x1, y y1,
           coalesce(lead(x) over w, first_value(x) over w) x2,
           coalesce(lead(y) over w, first_value(y) over w) y2
    from pts window w as (partition by k, id, n order by ord)
  ) s where y1 <> y2
),
eband as materialized (
  select e.*, b band from edges e,
       generate_series(floor(least(y1, y2) * 50)::int, floor(greatest(y1, y2) * 50)::int) b
),
bbox as materialized (
  select k, id, min(x) minx, max(x) maxx, min(y) miny, max(y) maxy from pts group by k, id
),
en_conc as materialized (
  select d.gml_id
  from det d
  join bbox b on b.k = 'c' and d.lon between b.minx and b.maxx and d.lat between b.miny and b.maxy
  join eband e on e.k = 'c' and e.id = b.id and e.band = d.band
  where (e.y1 > d.lat) <> (e.y2 > d.lat)
    and d.lon < (e.x2 - e.x1) * (d.lat - e.y1) / (e.y2 - e.y1) + e.x1
  group by d.gml_id, b.id
  having count(*) % 2 = 1
),
det2 as materialized (
  select d.* from det d where d.gml_id in (select gml_id from en_conc)
),
en_area as (
  select d.gml_id
  from det2 d
  join bbox b on b.k = 'a' and d.lon between b.minx and b.maxx and d.lat between b.miny and b.maxy
  join eband e on e.k = 'a' and e.id = b.id and e.band = d.band
  where (e.y1 > d.lat) <> (e.y2 > d.lat)
    and d.lon < (e.x2 - e.x1) * (d.lat - e.y1) / (e.y2 - e.y1) + e.x1
  group by d.gml_id, b.id
  having count(*) % 2 = 1
)
select count(distinct gml_id) from en_area
